methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The energy baseline (Eb) is a fundamental element of an energy management system since, according to ISO 50001:2018, it is a quantitative reference against which changes in energy performance are compared. However, neither the ISO 50001 nor ISO 50006 standard mentions how to calculate the baseline, leaving it to the free interpretation of the person performing the assessment.
